faqs.a:
Any person, firm or corporation, including the officers of a corporation who are responsible
               for its actions or inaction, and the partners or members of a partnership, firm or
               joint venture, who violate or cause the violation of any of the provisions of this
               chapter shall be guilty of an offense, and upon conviction thereof, any person, firm,
               or corporation, including such officers, partners or members, shall be punishable
               by a fine, or by imprisonment, or by both, not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 31-1; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
